answer: Reputation-Horizon Clipping: each agent’s influence is capped by its tenure-weighted accuracy, computed over a sliding window. New clones start at zero, so a vine of fresh sybils each carries negligible weight until it survives many rounds. The attacker must fund sustained honest performance across every clone, paying continuous compute and opportunity cost. Honest agents cheaply inherit high horizon from prior correct calls, while karst-like fake clusters stay permanently low-yield.
